items.title: Gridiron Census: anonymous league totals on by default with a one-click opt-out
items.stageRationale: FORGE/FB public-beta hardening, wave 1 of the S133 order.
items.recipe: A pulse-1 contract of capped counters with no identifier; the browser sends them with no credentials and stores nothing but the player's own off switch; GPC and Do Not Track mean off. The service keeps one total per metric per day (schema 4). Totals: game sessions, returning sessions, franchises founded, first games, games, seasons, players drafted, titles, Hall of Famers, trades, signings and minutes managed. Shown on the stats page and the landing page; documented on Privacy, agents.json and llms.txt.
items.acceptance: Negative controls send nothing with GPC, Do Not Track or the switch off; a pulse with an identifier, unknown key or over-cap value is refused; the store writes no browser or address; a new franchise's opening week and club Hall of Fame inductions are counted from the game's own response.

items.title: Frame Matters: a player's body changes the games
items.stageRationale: FORGE/FB public-beta hardening, wave 2 of the S133 order.
items.recipe: physicalProfile.js measures each position's centre from the live league per game (never a constant, never stored) and turns height, weight, wingspan, arm and hand into bounded rating edges: pass blocking, pass rush, run fits, coverage, tackling, catch radius, passer sight, broken tackles and ball security; heavy-and-fast and light-for-position bodies carry more injury risk, and the scouting medical read uses the same model.
items.acceptance: Every edge is bounded (4 rating points, injury multiplier 0.9-1.2, fumble 0.85-1.15); no new random draws; golden master v8 written once with v7 frozen by hash.

premises.claim: Height, weight and limb measurements never reach the play sim.

items.premise: Height, weight and limb measurements never reach the play sim.

L2.recipe: physicalProfile.js measures each position's centre from the live league per game (never a constant, never stored) and turns height, weight, wingspan, arm and hand into bounded rating edges: pass blocking, pass rush, run fits, coverage, tackling, catch radius, passer sight, broken tackles and ball security; heavy-and-fast and light-for-position bodies carry more injury risk, and the scouting medical read uses the same model.

executionLog.note: Deferred.

Kept deferred: the boot budget governs JavaScript (649,284/650,000) and the stylesheet is cached by the service worker after the first visit; a split risks every screen's styling for a first-visit gain that was not measured.

Shipped by page type rather than by screen: the build emits the part of styles.css that public pages can use (45 KB of 178 KB minified, source order kept, so the cascade is unchanged) and the landing page inlines it; the game keeps the full sheet byte for byte. No large screen-specific block exists (largest prefix group 2.4 KB), so a per-screen split would save little and reorder the game's cascade. Pixel parity: every public page in both themes at 1366 and 390 matched the full sheet except screenshots still decoding. Boot JS unchanged at 649,989.
